name: Chrono Island Meadow & Market
summary: Navigate south through the Water Labyrinth to land at Chrono Island (Five Island), a quiet settlement bordering an expansive wildflower meadow. Visit the house directly south of the Pokémon Center to discover the archipelago's Heart Scale Merchant, who offers unlimited Heart Scales for $5,000 each. Search the swaying grass in Chrono Meadow to retrieve a Max Potion, and activate the Poké Radar to detect camouflaged wild Kecleon hiding among the flowers. Advance southeast toward the ominous industrial complex in the meadow.

items.name: Max Potion
items.method: Lying on the ground among the wildflowers in Chrono Meadow

items.name: Heart Scale
items.method: Purchased from the merchant house south of the Pokémon Center ($5,000 each)
